questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, the careers of scientists can be determined by ____
questions.evidence: The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, b

options.en: how many citations their works contain.
options.reason: 方向倒置。原文讨论论文被引用多少次，不是论文自身参考文献表中包含多少条引文。

options.en: how many times their papers are cited.
options.reason: 原文说科学家职业发展不仅取决于论文数量与声望，`but even more so` 取决于论文吸引到的引用。`citations attracted by these papers` 就是论文被他人引用的次数，B 准确改写了这一决定因素。

options.en: the prestige of the people they work with.
options.reason: 偷换对象。原文说的是论文的声望以及所在机构的声誉，没有提合作者的声望。

options.en: the status they have in scientific circles.
options.reason: 因果倒置。科学家的职业地位是论文及引用表现影响的结果，不是原文列出的决定因素。

questions.stem: The support service consultancies tend to ____
questions.evidence: Recently, another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged: so-called support service consultancies that provide language

options.en: recommend journals to their clients.
options.reason: 无中生有。咨询机构向作者和期刊提供语言、编辑支持，但文中没有说它推荐投稿期刊。

options.en: list citation patterns for their clients.
options.reason: 张冠李戴。识别可疑引用模式的是 2016 年研究人员开发的算法，不是支持服务咨询机构。

options.en: ask authors to include extra citations.
options.reason: 支持服务咨询机构会 `advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles`，即建议投稿作者在文章中增加一批引用。`contributors` 对应 authors，`add a number of` 对应 include extra，故选 C。

options.en: advise contributors to cite each other.
options.reason: 混淆两种操纵。作者群体相互引用属于前述传统引用联盟；咨询机构这里只是要求作者添加若干引用，未必是彼此互引。

questions.stem: The function of the “milk cow” journals is to ____
questions.evidence: These journals can act as milk cows where every single article in an issue may cite a specific paper or a series of papers.

options.en: boost citation counts for certain authors.
options.reason: “奶牛”期刊让某一期的每篇文章都引用指定论文或一组论文，从而为相关论文及作者批量增加被引次数。下文提到论文可在发表当年累积 150 多次引用，进一步印证其功能是抬高引用数据。

options.en: help scholars publish articles at low cost.
options.reason: 无中生有。文中没有讨论发表费用，重点是集中提供引用。

options.en: instruct first-time contributors in citation.
options.reason: 无中生有。文章没有涉及初次投稿者或引用规范教学。

options.en: increase the readership of new journals.
options.reason: 主体错位。“奶牛”期刊在为指定论文或其他期刊提供引用，并非提升自身读者数量。

questions.stem: What can be learned about Scopus from the last two paragraphs?
questions.evidence: Scopus itself has all the data necessary to detect this malpractice. > Red flags include a large number of citations to an article

options.en: It fosters competition among citation providers.
options.reason: 无中生有。文中说一些期刊充当引用提供者，没有说 Scopus 促进它们竞争。

options.en: It has the capability to identify suspicious citations.
options.reason: Scopus 掌握检测此类不当行为所需的全部数据，而论文在首年获得大量引用就是可识别的危险信号。拥有必要数据和明确异常指标，说明它具备发现可疑引用的能力。

options.en: It hinders the growth of “international” journals.
options.reason: 与原文不符。Scopus 收录了大量新“国际”期刊，文章没有说它阻碍这些期刊发展。

options.en: It is established to prevent citation manipulation.
options.reason: 把能力偷换成创立目的。原文只说 Scopus 现有数据足以检测操纵，未说明该数据库是为防止引用操纵而建立。

questions.stem: What should an author do to deal with citation manipulators?
questions.evidence: And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities: when an editor, a reviewer, or a support service asks you t

options.en: Take legal action.
options.reason: 无中生有。作者应向期刊举报，原文没有要求提起法律诉讼。

options.en: Demand an apology.
options.reason: 无中生有。文中不涉及要求操纵者道歉。

options.en: Seek professional advice.
options.reason: 方向错误。支持服务本身可能提出不当要求，作者得到的明确建议是拒绝并举报，而不是另行寻求专业意见。

options.en: Reveal their misconduct.
options.reason: 作者遇到编辑、审稿人或支持服务机构要求添加不当引用时，应拒绝照办，并 `report the request to the journal`。向期刊报告这一要求，就是揭露操纵者的不端行为。
